issues: No sign of getting around the measurement. The diff adds no file or network access and no pasted values. Test molecules are only passed through the LightGBM model to get leaf indices; their labels are never used.

No bug that makes the result meaningless. leaf_onehot uses width=31, which matches num_leaves=31, so the leaf indices (0 to 30) fit. The one-hot matrix is about 776 x 12400 floats, roughly 77 MB, well under the 6 GB limit.

Methodological caveat: the leaf kernel comes from a LightGBM model fitted to the same training targets, so choose_sigma2 picks the GP noise on a kernel that is already fitted to y. That may make the third component overconfident. It does not leak test labels or invalidate the score.
Minor cleanliness issue: W_DESC is no longer used in the return line, which is now an equal-weight 1/3 blend, so the constant is dead code. The new branch adds complexity with no gain.

Recomputed z: the candidate (0.4984) is 0.0016 worse than the incumbent mean (0.4968). The standard error is 0.0070 * sqrt(1/1 + 1/2) ≈ 0.00857, so z ≈ -0.187 (negative means worse). This matches the harness's -0.185 up to rounding of the means. The provisional reject is consistent with the numbers.
